reference.observation: After the title clears, teal crests span both edges, concentrate into lateral dots, then persist only at the bottom. The color picks up contrast in darker regions; it does not act like an evenly luminous display over a bright surface.

destination.protection: all middle rows and bright portions of the actual target plate; the cream vertical surface is not an emitter

effect.change: attenuate extra emission over bright target pixels
effect.scope: same geometry/timing, local light gain only
